summary: Booking engine still ReserveAmerica (parkId 530177; deep link added at entry level). Hookups, sites, dump/showers/flush toilets/laundry added. The $38 tier includes exactly AWH's sites 5, 6, 8 and 12, and imagery shows the lakeside row's pads ~20-40 m from Laura S. Walker Lake across open ground - AWH note kept verbatim, lakefront stands. Pin within ~80 m of the per-site centroid (31.14172,-82.21527). Season (year-round) and military discount left.
